name: Result Management System for Institutions
author: ASTGD

sections.description:
Result Management System for Institutions is designed to simplify result management for educational institutions. This plugin enables you to display detailed marksheets, import student data via CSV, and customize the marksheet layout to suit your needs.

Key Features:

  1. Seamlessly integrate with WordPress for hassle-free setup and management.
  2. Navigate effortlessly with an intuitive dashboard designed for optimal user experience.
  3. Manage unlimited classes, departments, sections, subjects, exams and additional fields.
  4. Class/Department-wise subject management.
  5. Facilities for individual and multi-student marks addition.
  6. Automatically calculate and display result metrics.
  7. Strong dashboard and settings.
  8. Allow students or admins to print or save results as PDFs with a single click.
  9. Fully customizable marksheets: hide fields or rename them as needed.
  10. Easily add, update, or delete student results.
  11. Import/export student records and results using CSV.
  12. Protect sensitive information with robust security measures and data encryption.

How to Use:

  1. Set Up Institute Profile: Configure your institution’s details to personalize the result portal.
  2. Configure Academic Structure:
    -Add Classes (e.g., HSC 1st Year, HSC 2nd Year).
    -Add Departments (e.g., Science, Arts, Commerce).
    -Add Sections (e.g., A, B, C).
  3. Assign Subjects to appropriate Classes.
  4. Set Up Examination Framework:
    -Add Exam Years (e.g., 2024-2025).
    -Add Exam Names (e.g., Mid-Term, Final).
  5. Add Student Records: Import or manually add student records with complete information.
  6. Configure Portal Settings: Set the public result portal URL in General Settings.
  7. Use the [astgdrmsys_show_result] shortcode in any post or page to allow students to search by Roll Number and Class.

Libraries Used

This plugin uses the following third-party JavaScript and CSS libraries. Minified versions are included for performance, and original, human-readable source files are provided when possible to comply with WordPress.org guidelines.

PDFObject

  • Version: 2.3.1
  • License: MIT
  • Project URL: https://github.com/pipwerks/PDFObject
  • Minified: js/pdfobject.min.js
  • Source (unminified): js/pdfobject.js (included in plugin)

jsPDF

  • Version: 3.0.1 (Build: 2025-03-17)
  • License: MIT
  • Project URL: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
  • Minified: js/jspdf.umd.min.js
  • Note: This version internally referenced a CDN fallback for PDFObject. This has been overridden by including a local copy (pdfobject.min.js and pdfobject.js) to meet WordPress.org guidelines.

html2canvas

  • Version: 1.4.1
  • License: MIT
  • Project URL: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
  • Minified: js/html2canvas.min.js
  • Note: Source is publicly available at the above URL.

Bootstrap CSS

  • Version: 4.5.3
  • License: MIT
  • Project URL: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
  • Minified: css/bootstrap.min.css
  • Note: Only the CSS file is used; no Bootstrap JavaScript components are included.
sections.installation:
Simple Steps:

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to “Plugins” → “Add New”.
  3. Search for “Result Management System for Institutions”.
  4. Click “Install Now” and activate the plugin.

Alternatively:
1. Upload the result-management-system.zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
2. Extract the contents of the zip file.
3. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.

Once installed, you will find the “Result Management System for Institutions” menu in the WordPress admin panel.
sections.faq:
Q: What is Result Management System for Institutions?

A: It is a WordPress plugin for managing and displaying student results, designed to streamline the process for educational institutions.
This plugin is a comprehensive solution designed to streamline the process of managing academic results. It allows users, such as educators and administrators, to easily edit, delete, and publish results. This system simplifies the workflow by providing an intuitive interface that enables efficient tracking and reporting of student performance, ensuring that all stakeholders have access to accurate and timely information.

Q: Is the plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

A: Yes, the Plugin is fully compatible with the latest stable version of WordPress. We ensure that our plugin is regularly updated to meet the latest WordPress standards and to provide users with a seamless experience.

Q: Can I import/export results?

A: Yes, you can easily import and export results using the Plugin. The plugin supports CSV and Excel formats, allowing for straightforward data management. This feature enables you to efficiently transfer results between systems, making it easier to handle large datasets and maintain accurate records.

Q: Does the plugin allow PDF export?

A: Yes, results can be saved as PDFs with a single click.

Q: How can I get support for the Result Management System?

A: We offer dedicated support for users of the plugin through multiple channels. You can reach out to our support team by emailing info@astgd.com, where our representatives will assist you with any inquiries or issues you may encounter. Additionally, we provide a live chat option on our website for immediate assistance during business hours, ensuring that you receive prompt help when needed.
